data.name: Adlan
data.gender_notes: Adlan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'd-l-n' meaning 'to be gentle, kind, and merciful'. The name Adlan is often given to boys born into noble and generous families, reflecting their parents' virtues and aspirations. The name Adlan carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Adlan usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of kindness, compassion, and mercy.
data.etymology: Adlan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adlan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: أدلان
in_arabic.meaning: المكان الأعلى، المحتفظ بالأمور العليا، المختار
in_arabic.long_meaning: أصل الكلمة يعود إلى العادة العربية القديمة، حيث كان للملك المختار حق اختيار المحتفظ بالأمور العليا، والمكان الأعلى هو المركز الذي يحكم من خلاله، في هذا السياق يرمي الاسم أدلان إلى إعطاء الطفل صلاحيات القيادة العليا والذكاء الإلهي، يُعتبر هذا الاسم شائعًا في بعض الدول العربية مثل الأردن ولبنان والمغرب، ويستمر في التداول والاستخدام في العصر الحديث من خلال ثقافة المسلمين.

in_urdu.name: ادلان
in_urdu.meaning: عالی مقام، محتفظ باُمور عُلیا، مختار
in_urdu.long_meaning: ادلان نام کے معنی ہیں عالی مقام، محتفظ باُمور عُلیا، مختار، یہ نام عرب قوم کی روایات سے متعلق ہے جس کے مطابق بادشاہ مختار کا حق تھا کہ وہ اپنے ملک کی اہم ترین امور کو منتخب کرے، یہ نام مسلم والدین کے درمیان اپنی اہمیت کے باعث بڑا مقبول ہے، اس کا استعمال پاکستان، بھارت اور مشرق وسطی کی مسلم ممالک میں بھی پایا جاتا ہے اور مسلم دنیا میں اس کا استعمال جاری ہے۔

in_english.name: Adlan
in_english.long_meaning: The name Adlan has its roots in ancient Arabic culture, where the king had the right to choose the person responsible for the superior matters, the exalted place is the center from which he rules, in this context, the name Adlan aims to give the child the authority of high leadership and divine wisdom, it is a popular name in some Arabic-speaking countries such as Jordan, Lebanon, and Morocco, and continues to be used in modern times through Muslim culture, it is also associated with leadership, wisdom, and high moral values.

data.cultural_impact: The name Adlan embodies the essential values of Arab-Islamic culture. In traditional Arab societies, hospitality and kindness towards guests and strangers were highly esteemed virtues, reflecting the moral and social fabric of the community. The name Adlan represents this noble heritage, conveying the importance of gentleness, kindness, and generosity, not just as personal qualities, but as fundamental aspects of social interactions and communal ties.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Adlan lies in its deeper meaning, which ties in with Islamic teachings on the virtues of kindness and compassion. In Sufi philosophy, the path towards self-realization and closeness to God is often viewed as a journey of kindness and compassion towards oneself and others. The name Adlan can be seen as a reminder to pursue this spiritual path, striving to embody the qualities of gentleness, kindness, and mercy, which cultivate inner peace and help foster harmonious relationships with others.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun describes Adlan as a Berber chief who ruled Algeria and Tunisia around 1350 AD and was a contemporary of Abu Inan Faris al-Abadi, the Hafsid ruler of Tunisia.
Adlan was also the name of an Arab general under the Umayyad Caliph Al-Walid I (705-715 AD) who led the Muslim army to victories in Syria and Iraq during the early Islamic conquests.
